about: docs/page.md. `valid`: a program that must check. `refusals`: a program and the rule tag that refuses it. A program is `page` (the declaration), `view` (the view of component C, default a Main with an id) and `extra_state`, or a whole `program`. `{N:c}` is the character c N times. `files` are written beside the program: a fixture of tests/fixtures/page, a text, `hex` bytes, or `sparse` (a file of that many bytes that starts with `head`). Checked by crates/cancho-ui/tests/page.rs.

valid.name: every entry
valid.page: page { title: "T"; lang: "en"; description: "A description."; share_description: "A card text."; canonical: "https://example.org/dir/"; image: "card.png" alt: "A card."; icon: "icon.png"; touch_icon: "icon.png"; alternate: "a.md" title: "As text"; alternate: "a.json" title: "As data"; skip_link: "Skip to content"; }

valid.name: a language with a region and a script
an icon that is an ico, a jpeg and a webp
a card that is a jpeg, with a canonical that is a file
valid.page: page { title: "T"; lang: "en"; canonical: "https://example.org/dir/index.html"; image: "card.jpg" alt: "A."; }

valid.name: a card that is lossy and one lossless webp
valid.page: page { title: "T"; lang: "en"; canonical: "https://example.org:8443/"; image: "lossy.webp" alt: "A."; }

valid.name: an alternate of each kind
valid.page: page { title: "T"; lang: "en"; alternate: "a.md" title: "m"; alternate: "a.txt" title: "t"; alternate: "a.xml" title: "x"; alternate: "a.json" title: "j"; }
